questions.question: A person's salary has increased from Rs. 7,000 to Rs. 12,000. What is the percentage increase in his salary?
questions.solution:

questions.question: A and B can do a piece of work in 25 days. B alone can do 66 (2)/(3)% of the same work in 30 days. In how many days can A alone do (4/15) part of same work?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Days taken by A and B together to do total work = 25 days

Days taken by B to do 66(2)/(3)% of total work = 30 days

**Formula used: **

No of days taken = (Total work)/(Efficiency)

**Calculation:**

Days taken by B to do (66(2)/(3)% = 2/3) ​of total work = 30

⇒ Days taken by B to do total work = 30 × 3/2 = 45 days

Total work = LCM of (25, 45) = 225 

The efficiency of A and B together = 225/25 = 9

The efficiency of B = 225/45 = 5

The efficiency of A = 9 – 5 = 4

Days taken by A to do (4/15) part of total work = (225/4) × (4/15) = 15 days

**∴ Time taken by A to do (4/15) part of the total work is 15 days**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** 

 Days taken by A and B together to do total work = 25 days

 Days taken by B to do total work = 30 × 3/2 = 45 days

Total work = LCM of (25, 45) = 225

The efficiency of A and B together = 225/25 = 9

The efficiency of B = 225/45 = 5

The efficiency of A = 9 – 5 = 4

Days taken by A to do (4/15) part of total work = (225/4) × (4/15) = 15 days

questions.question: If x² + 8y² + 12y - 4xy + 9 = 0, then the value of (7x + 8y) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x² + 8y² + 12y – 4xy + 9 = 0

**Formula used:**

(A - B)² = A² – 2AB + B²

(A + B)² = A² + 2AB + B²

**Calculation:**

x² + 8y² + 12y – 4xy + 9 = 0

⇒ x² – 4xy + 4y² + 4y² + 12y + 9 = 0

⇒ (x – 2y)² + (2y + 3)² = 0

⇒ x – 2y = 0, 2y + 3 = 0 

⇒ x = 2y, 2y = -3 

⇒ x = -3, y = -3/2

Now,

7x + 8y = 7 × (-3) + 8 × (-3/2)

⇒ -21 – 12 = -33

**∴ The correct answer is -33 **

questions.question: If x² – 3x + 1 = 0, then the value of (x⁴ + (1)/(x²)) div (x²+1) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x2 - 3x + 1 = 0

**Formula used:**

x³ + 1/x³ = (x + 1/x)³ – 3(x + 1/x)

**Calculation:**

x2 – 3x + 1 = 0

⇒ x² + 1 = 3x

⇒ x + 1/x = 3

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 = (x + 1/x)3 – 3(x + 1/x)

⇒ x3 + 1/x³ = 27 – 9

⇒ x3 + 1/x³ = 18

Required value = (x⁴ + 1/x²) ÷ (x² + 1)

⇒ x(x³ + 1/x³) ÷ x(x + 1/x)

⇒ (x3 + 1/x3) ÷ (x + 1/x)

⇒ 18 ÷ 3 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6**

questions.question: If six - digit number 5x2y6z is divisible by 7, 11 and 13, then the value of (x – y + 3z) is:
questions.solution:

**Given:**

**Concept used:**

7 × 11 × 13 = 1001, when any 3 digit number multiplied by 1001 then it repeats itself and always completely divisible by 7,11 and 13.

**Calculation:**

Let 3 digit number be pqr.

⇒ pqr × 1001 = 5x2y6z

⇒ pqrpqr = 5x2y6z

Compare both sides

⇒ p = 5, q = 6 and r = 2

Hence, that number is 562562.

⇒ 5x2y6z = 562562

by comparing both numbers, x = 6, y = 5, and z = 2 

Required value = (x – y + 3z)

⇒ 6 – 5 + 3 × 2

questions.question: If the annual rate of simple interest increases from 11% to 17 (1)/(2)%, then a person's yearly income increases by Rs. 1,071.20. The simple interest (in Rs.) on the same sum at 10% for 5 years is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest changes from 11% to 17(1)/(2)%

Due to change of rate of interest yearly income increases by Rs. 1071.20

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × T)/100

Where,

P → Principal 

R → Rate 

T → Time

**Calculation:**

Difference between two interest rates = 17(1)/(2)% – 11% = (13/2)%

⇒ Increased income = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 1071.20 = (P × (13/2) × 1)/100

⇒ (107120 × 2)/13 = P

⇒ P = 16480 

Simple Interest = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ (16480 × 10 × 5)/100

⇒ 1648 × 5

⇒ 8240 Rs.

**∴ The simple interest for five years at 10% is 8240 Rs.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** Difference between two interest rates = 17(1)/(2)% – 11% = (13/2)%

Increased income = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 1071.20 = (P × (13/2) × 1)/100

⇒ P = 16480 

Simple Interest = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ (16480 × 10 × 5)/100

⇒ 8240

questions.question: If the difference between the compounded interest and simple interest at 17% on a sum of money for 2 years (compounded annually) is Rs. 433.50, then compound interest (in Rs.) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

R = 17%

Difference between compound interest and simple interest for 2 years = Rs. 433.50

**Formula used:**

Difference between compound interest and simple interest for 2 years = P × R/100 × R/100

Compound interest = P × (1 + R/100)T - P

**Calculation:**

Difference between compound interest and simple interest for 2 years = P × R/100 × R/100

⇒ 433.50 = P × 17/100 × 17/100

⇒ 43350 × 100 = P × 289

⇒ P = 4335000/289 = 15000

Compound interest = P × (1+R/100)T - P

⇒ 15000 × (1 + 17/100)² - 15000

⇒ 15000 × [(117/100 × 117/100) – 1]

⇒ 15000 × (13689 – 10000)/10000

⇒ (15 × 3689)/10

⇒ Rs. 5533.5

**∴ Compound interest for two years is Rs. 5533.5 **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

2 years Effective rate for S.I. = RT 

⇒ 17 × 2 = 34% 

2 years Effective rate for C.I = 2R + R²/100 

⇒ 2 × 17 + 17²/100

⇒ 34 + 2.89 = 36.89% 

Difference in rates = 36.89% – 34% = 2.89% 

Now, 2.89% = 433.50 

Here we have to find C.I so = (433.50/2.89) × 36.89 = 5533.5 

**∴ The compound interest for two years is Rs. 5533.5**

questions.question: A rectangular lawn whose length is twice of its breadth is extended by having four semi-circular portions on its sides. What is the total area (in m²) of the lawn if the smaller side of the rectangle is 12 m? (Take π = 3.14)
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Breadth of rectangle (B) = 12 m

Length of rectangle (L) = 2 × Breadth = 24 m

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = L × B

Area of semicircle = πr²/2

Where, 

L → Length of the rectangle 

B → Breadth of the rectangle 

r → Radius of circle 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fba246fa2c5b53ece8b823659a181ff703fb8d825835c73e859afac33b3b5d25.png] 

Four semi-circular portions are constructed on the sides of the rectangle

Let radius of small semi-circle be r and big semi-circle be R

⇒ AD = 2r and AB = 2R

⇒ r = 6 and R = 12

Total area of the newly constructed lawn = Area of rectangle + Area of the four semi-circles

⇒ L × B + 2(small semi-circle area) + 2(Big semi-circle area)

⇒ 12 × 24 + 2(3.14 × 36)/2 + 2(3.14 × 144)/2

⇒ 288 + (3.14 × 36) + (3.14 × 144)

⇒ 288 + 3.14 × 180

⇒ 288 + 565.2

⇒ 853.2 m²

**∴ Total area of lawn is 853.2 m²**

questions.question: A solid sphere of radius 11 cm is melted and recast into small solid spheres of radius 2 cm each. How many maximum number (in integer) of such spheres can be made?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of solid sphere = 11 cm

Radius of small solid sphere = 2 cm 

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a sphere = (4/3)πr³

Number of small sphere = (Volume of solid sphere)/(Volume of small solid sphere)

Where, r = Radius of the sphere 

**Calculation:**

Volume of the solid sphere with radius 11 cm = (4/3) × π × 11³

Volume of the small solid sphere with radius 2 cm = (4/3) × π × 2³

Number of small solid sphere = (4/3) × π × 11³/(4/3) × π × 2³ = 1331/8 = 166.37 ≈ 166

**∴ Maximum 166 of such spheres can be made.**

questions.question: The least number which is exactly divisible by 4, 5, 8, 10 and 12 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers 4, 5, 8, 10, 12

**Concept Used:**

Least Number divisible by a set of Number = Least common multiple (LCM) of that set of numbers

**Calculation:**

4 = 2²

5 = 5¹

8 = 2³

10 = 2¹ × 5¹

12 = 2² × 3¹

Least Common Multiple (LCM) of 4, 5, 8, 10, 12 = 2³ × 3¹ × 5¹ 

⇒ 8 × 3 × 5 = 120

**∴ 120 is the least number which is exactly divisible by 4, 5, 8, 10, 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Least common multiple: The least common multiple of numbers is the smallest non-zero common numbers which are the multiple of all the numbers.

questions.question: The students of a class donated a sum of Rs. 2,809 to the Fund. Each student donated as many rupees as the number of students in the class. The number of students in the class is:

questions.question: A man spends 75% of his income. If his income increases by 28% and his expenditure increases by 20%, then what is the increase or decrease percentage in his savings?

**Given:**

Man spends 75% of his income.

Income increases by 28% 

Expenditure increases by 20%

**Concept:**

Saving = Income – Expenditure 

**Solution**:

Let the Income of a man = 100

Expenditure = 75% of 100

⇒ (75/100) × 100 = 75

Saving = Income – Expenditure 

Initial Saving = 100 – 75 = 25 ----(1)

Now as per the question,

His income increased by 28%

⇒ His new income = Old income + 28% of Old income

⇒ His new income = (128/100) × 100 = 128

Similarly, his expenditure increased by 20%

⇒ His new expenditure = (120/100) × 75

⇒ His new expenditure = 90

Saving₍ₙₑw₎ = Income₍ₙₑw₎ – Expenditure₍ₙₑw₎

⇒ Saving(new) = 128 - 90 = 38 ----(2)

Now, % increase in savings = {(38 – 25)/25} × 100 ----(from 1 and 2)

⇒ 13 × 4 = 52%

**∴ The % increase in saving is 52%**

questions.question: The length of the shadow of a vertical pole on the ground in 36 m. If the angle of elevation of the sun at that time is θ, such that secθ = (13/12) then what is the height (in m) of the pole?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of shadow = 36m.

Let the height of pole = (x) m.

**Formula Used:**

sec2θ = tan2θ + 1

tanθ = P/B 

Where, 

P = Perpendicular 

B =Base

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d33cf735d73027f35bd549b499a047c7b245eff8ae52c39b16fe577e7a6ca469.png] 

secθ = 13/12 

⇒ sec2θ = tan2θ + 1

⇒ (13/12)2 = tan2θ + 1

⇒ tan2θ = 1 - (13/12)2 

⇒ tan2θ = 1 - 169/144

⇒ tan2θ = 25/144

⇒ tanθ = 5/12 

tanθ = P/B 

tanθ = x/36

⇒ 5/12 = x/36

⇒ x = 36 × (5/12)

⇒ x = 15

**∴ The height of pole is 15 m.**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 8,200 was divided among A, B and C in such a way that A had Rs. 500 more than B and C had Rs. 300 more than A. How much C's share (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

Total sum of money = 8200

A had Rs. 500 more than B and C had Rs. 300 more than A.

**Concept used:**

Using linear equation. 

**Calculation :**

Let the money of B be 'x'

So, money of A = x + 500

Now, money of C = x + 500 + 300 = x + 800

According to the Question ,

x + x + 500 + x + 800 = 8200

⇒ 3x + 1300 = 8200

⇒ 3x = 8200 – 1300

⇒ 3x = 6900

⇒ x = 2300

So, C's share = 2300 + 800 = Rs. 3100

**∴ C's share is Rs. 3100.**

questions.question: A person covers a distance of 300 km and then returns to the starting point. The time taken by him for the outward journey is 5 hours more than time taken for the return journey. If he returned at a speed of 10 km/h more than the speed of going. What was the speed (in km/h) for the outward journey?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Distance covered by the person in a single journey = 300km

Time taken by him for the outward journey = 5 hours more than the time taken for the return journey.

The return speed is 10km/h more than the speed of going.

**Formula used: **

Distance covered = Speed × Time taken

**Calculation: **

Let the speed of outward journey be ‘x’ km/h

Hence, the speed of return journey will be (x + 10) km/h

So, time taken in return journey = 300/(x + 10) hours

Time taken in outward journey = (300/x) hours

According to the question,

⇒ (300/x) – 300/(x + 10) = 5

⇒ [300(x + 10) – 300x]/x(x + 10) = 5

⇒ [300x + 3000 – 300x] = 5x(x + 10)

⇒ 3000 = 5x² + 50x

⇒ 5x² + 50x – 3000 = 0

⇒ x² + 10x – 600 = 0

⇒ x² + 30x – 20x – 600 = 0

⇒ x(x + 30) – 20(x + 30) = 0

⇒ (x – 20)(x + 30) = 0

⇒ x = 20, -30

⇒ x = 20km/h as negative speed is not possible.

**∴**** The speed for the outward journey is 20km/h**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** **Concept:**

[(Speed 1 × Speed 2) / Speed difference] × Time difference = Total distance

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of outward journey be ‘x’ km/h

Hence, the speed of return journey will be (x + 10) km/h

So, 

(x times (x+10))/(10) times 5 = 300

⇒ x times (x+10) = 600

⇒ x times (x+10) = 20 times 30

⇒ x = 20

∴ The speed for the outward journey is 20km/h

questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral such that AB is a diameter of the circle circumscribing it and ∠ADC = 118°. What is the measure of ∠BAC?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

AB is a diameter.

ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral in which ∠ADC = 118°

**Concept used:**

The angle formed by the diameter of the circle at the circumference of the circle is always 90° 

ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral 

So, ∠ADC + ∠ABC = 180° 

**Calculation: **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5126e1757bbd676c6b981c5972ddcea895ec17995ff3ce00051eb653524474a1.png] **

In a cyclic quadrilateral, the sum of each pair of opposite angles is 180 degrees.

⇒ ∠ADC + ∠ABC = 180°

⇒ 118° + ∠ABC = 180°

⇒ ∠ABC = 62°

∠ACB = 90° ----(The angle formed by the diameter of the circle at the circumference of the circle always 90°)

In ΔABC,

∠BAC + ∠ACB + ∠ABC = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC + 90° + 62° = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC = 28°

**∴ The value of ∠BAC is 28° **

questions.question: A and B can do a piece of work in 36 days. B and C can do the same work in 60 days. A and C can do the same work in 45 days. In how many days can B alone complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

A and B can do a piece of work in 36 days,

B and C can do the same work in 60 days,

A and C can do the same work in 45 days.

**Concept used:**

Efficiency = 1/(Total time)

**Calculation: **

(A + B)’s 1 day work = 1/36 ----(i) 

(B + C)’s 1 day work = 1/60 ----(ii) 

(C + A)’s 1 day work = 1/45 ----(iii)

From equations (i), (ii) and (iii),

2(A + B + C)’s 1 day work = 1/36 + 1/60 + 1/45

⇒ (5 + 3 + 4)/180 = 1/15

⇒ (A + B + C)’s 1 day work = 1/(15 × 2) = 1/30 ----(iv)

From equations (iii) and (iv) we get

B’s 1 day work = 1/30 – 1/45 = (3 – 2)/90 = 1/90

Time taken by B alone to complete the work = 90

**∴**** B alone can complete the same work in 90 days**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****

Let us find the LCM of 36, 60 and 45

LCM of 36, 60 and 45 = 180

Let the total work be 180 units. 

A + B can do = 180/36 = 5 units/day ----(i)

B + C can do = 180/60 = 3 units/day ----(ii)

C + A can do = 180/45 = 4 units/day ----(iii) 

Adding the above equations, we get 

2(A + B + C) = 5 + 3 + 4 

⇒ A + B + C = 12/2 = 6 ----(iv)

Subtracting equation (iii) from (iv) 

B = 6 - 4 = 2units/day 

⇒ Time taken by B = 180/2 = 90days

∴ B alone can complete the same work in 90 days
